items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Glimmer: open-weight 30B agentic model for local hardware
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Glimmer：開源 30B 參數本地 agentic 模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open-weight model optimized for always-on local agent workflows. It runs on consumer hardware (Mac or single consumer GPU after quantization under 20 GB), supports multi-step tool use, failure recovery and multimodal input, and is available under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 正式發布 Muse Glimmer，這是一款 30B 參數的開源權重模型，專為本地常駐 agent 工作流優化。量化後可在消費級硬體（Mac 或單一 GPU）運行，支援多步驟工具呼叫、失敗恢復與多模態輸入，採 Apache 2.0 授權並已上架 Hugging Face。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a concrete step toward practical on-device agents rather than another cloud-only frontier model. Success will depend on real-world latency, reliability across long tool chains, and whether the open weights accelerate community tooling faster than closed competitors.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是朝「實用本地 agent」邁出的具體一步，而非又一個雲端旗艦模型。成敗將取決於真實延遲、長工具鏈可靠性，以及開源權重能否比封閉競爭對手更快催生社群工具。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Glimmer, the next model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, and open sourcing the model weights under a permissive Apache 2.0 license.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們介紹來自 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的下一個模型 Muse Glimmer，並以寬鬆的 Apache 2.0 授權開源模型權重。

items_flat.title_en: Zuckerberg publishes “The Future is for Everyone” vision and launches community fund
items_flat.title_zh: Zuckerberg 發表《未來屬於每個人》長文並啟動社區基金
items_flat.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg released a long-form essay outlining Meta’s philosophy of personal superintelligence distributed to individuals rather than institutions, announced the Future Is For Everyone Fund to support data-center communities, and confirmed Meta will soon open weights for a version of Muse Spark 1.2.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mark Zuckerberg 發表長文闡述 Meta 以「個人超級智能」為核心、將能力分配給個人而非機構的哲學，並宣布 Future Is For Everyone Fund 支援資料中心所在社區，同時確認即將開放 Muse Spark 1.2 的部分權重。
items_flat.analysis_en: The essay reframes Meta’s open-weight strategy as a deliberate balance-of-power argument against centralized AI. The fund and forthcoming Spark 1.2 weights give the rhetoric operational teeth, though the actual safety and governance mechanisms remain to be tested in practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這篇長文把 Meta 的開源策略重新定位為對抗 AI 集中化的權力平衡論。基金與即將到來的 Spark 1.2 權重讓論述有實質落地，但實際安全與治理機制仍待實務檢驗。
items_flat.quote: We propose a philosophy based on individual empowerment as the source of prosperity, invention as the primary purpose of superintelligence, and balance of power as the foundation of safety.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們提出一套以個人賦能作為繁榮來源、發明作為超級智能主要目的、權力平衡作為安全基礎的哲學。

brief_en: Quiet day across frontier labs. Meta dominated with the open-weight release of Muse Glimmer (30B local agentic model) plus Mark Zuckerberg’s long-form vision post on personal superintelligence, open source, and a new community fund. No major model or product launches from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI or others in the window.
brief_zh: 今日各大廠相對平靜。Meta 主導：正式開源發布 Muse Glimmer（30B 可本地運行的 agentic 模型），同時 Mark Zuckerberg 發表長文闡述個人超級智能、開源與新社區基金願景。OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI 等無重大新模型或產品公告。
